###############################################################
# German Rework Expansion — characters
#
# IMPORTANT — why this file is NOT named GER.txt:
# Naming it GER.txt would replace vanilla's German character file
# wholesale, deleting Hitler, Himmler, every vanilla advisor and
# field marshal. Many vanilla GER decisions and events reference
# those characters via auto-generated scripted effects
# (GER_adolf_hitler = yes, etc.), so wiping them produces ~80
# "Unknown effect-type" errors and a broken country.
#
# Using a unique filename keeps vanilla intact — characters from
# both files merge.
#
# Eric Zemmour is defined here WITHOUT a country_leader role.
# That role is granted at runtime by the GER_a_new_hero focus
# completion via add_country_leader_role. This way Germany's
# politics screen and AI evaluation see vanilla state until the
# focus actually fires.
###############################################################

characters = {

	GER_eric_zemmour = {
		name = GER_eric_zemmour
		portraits = {
			civilian = {
				large = "GFX_Portrait_Eric_Zemmour"
			}
		}
	}

}
